record.original_question: Prove a super-linear lower bound for the stabilizer rank of quantum states in the stated d-qubit stabilizer framework.

evidence.quote: Problem 23. Prove a super linear lower bound for stabilizer rank.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and setup. Consider the n-qubit Hilbert space (ℂ²)^⊗n. The (pure) stabilizer states are the states obtained from |0⟩^⊗n by applying elements of the Clifford group; equivalently, they are the joint +1-eigenstates of maximal abelian subgroups of the n-qubit Pauli group (up to phases). The (exact) stabilizer rank χ(|ψ⟩) of a state |ψ⟩ ∈ (ℂ²)^⊗n is the smallest integer r such that there exist stabilizer states |s_1⟩, …, |s_r⟩ and complex coefficients c_1, …, c_r with
   |ψ⟩ = Σ_{i=1}^{r} c_i |s_i⟩.

The magic state is |T⟩ = cos(π/8)|0⟩ + e^{iπ/4} sin(π/8)|1⟩, and the n-fold tensor product |T⟩^⊗n is the canonical family used to study stabilizer rank.

Problem. Exhibit an explicit family of n-qubit quantum states |ψ_n⟩ (for example |T⟩^⊗n) and prove that
   χ(|ψ_n⟩) = ω(n),
i.e., establish a super-linear lower bound on the exact stabilizer rank of an explicit sequence of n-qubit states.
artifact.status_search_result: A quadratic Ω(n²) lower bound has been established for the approximate stabilizer rank (for a wide range of approximation parameters), giving a super-linear lower bound in the approximate setting. However, for the exact stabilizer rank of explicit families such as |T⟩^⊗n, no lower bound better than linear is known; thus the problem in its exact form appears to remain open, while the approximate version has been resolved super-linearly.

status_evidence.title: Quadratic Lower bounds on the Approximate Stabilizer Rank: A Probabilistic Approach
status_evidence.snippet: We improve the lower bound on the approximate rank to Ω(n^2) for a wide range of the approximation parameters.
status_evidence.claim: Super-linear (quadratic) lower bound for the approximate stabilizer rank is established.

status_evidence.title: Lower Bounds on Stabilizer Rank (Quantum journal)
status_evidence.snippet: Previous techniques could not lead to a better than a linear lower bound on the exact rank of |T⟩^⊗n.
status_evidence.claim: For the exact stabilizer rank, no better than linear lower bound was known prior to recent approximate-rank work.
